title: Adaptive Item-based Collaborative Structures via Noise Rescheduling in Diffusion for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23400v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete Diffusion Models (DDMs) have recently been introduced to recommendation systems, modeling user history as a token generation process via iterative denoising. However, while effective at capturing user-level sequential patterns, these methods often fail to explicitly integrate item-based collaborative filtering information, a critical component for accurate recommendation. This deficiency manifests in two key aspects: (1) the item representation is often semantic-focused, lacking collaborative priors for diffusion training; and (2) the denoising process employs a uniform noise schedule, treating all tokens indiscriminately and ignoring item-level adaptive structural dependencies. To bridge this gap, we propose ANR-DiffRec, a unified framework designed to encode item-based collaborative structures into discrete diffusion for generative recommendation. translated_title: 基于噪声重调度的自适应项目协作结构在生成式推荐中的扩散方法
translated_abstract: 离散扩散模型（DDMs）最近被引入推荐系统，通过迭代去噪将用户历史建模为标记生成过程。然而，尽管这些方法在捕捉用户级序列模式方面有效，它们往往未能明确整合基于项目的协同过滤信息，这是准确推荐的关键组成部分。这一缺陷体现在两个方面：（1）项目表示通常侧重于语义，缺乏用于扩散训练的协作先验；（2）去噪过程采用统一噪声调度，不加区分地处理所有标记，忽略了项目级自适应结构依赖性。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了ANR-DiffRec，一个统一框架，旨在将基于项目的协作结构编码到离散扩散中，用于生成式推荐。首先，我们显式纳入项目共现矩阵来引导语义表示，以注入协作先验；其次，我们设计了一个自适应噪声重调度机制，根据项目间的结构依赖动态调整去噪过程，从而增强模型对项目级交互的捕捉能力。通过在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验，ANR-DiffRec在推荐准确性和鲁棒性方面显著优于现有方法。
tldr: 提出ANR-DiffRec框架，通过引入项目共现矩阵和自适应噪声重调度，将基于项目的协作结构整合到离散扩散模型中，提升了生成式推荐的准确性和鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: The ANR-DiffRec framework integrates item-based collaborative structures into discrete diffusion via co-occurrence guidance and adaptive noise rescheduling, significantly improving generative recommendation accuracy and robustness.
